Dear Eduard,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support, I hope this email finds you well.
Following the issue Power Meter Failure on the charger we could find on the error flag related with the meter "timeSyncStatusIsOk":true".
So, on this situation we could see the charger is in the v7.0.5
Please update the firmware so we can deep in the logs again in case this issue still happens.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
